events.verdict: Towns (MIN) and Gobert (UTA) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Bayless (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position during Mitchell's (UTA) shot attempt as he moves along his path and does not make contact with his arm.
Deng (MIN) moves into Gobert (UTA) during the rebound and dislodges him.
Tolliver (MIN) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Crowder (UTA) after the release and allows him to land from his shot attempt before making marginal contact with his body.
Wiggins (MIN) makes marginal contact with Gobert's (UTA) arm and does not affect his SQBR.
Ingles (UTA) sets the screen on Towns (MIN) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Bayless (MIN) draws Mitchell (UTA) into the air towards him and the contact affects his jump shot attempt.
Towns (MIN) sets the screen on Mitchell (UTA) and does not deliver contact.
Ingles (UTA) sets the screen on Towns (MIN) and does not deliver contact.
Gobert (UTA) sets the screen on Bayless (MIN) and does not deliver contact.
Gobert (UTA) and Deng (MIN) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Deng (MIN) makes contact with Gobert's (UTA) head during his shot attempt.
Towns (MIN) sets the screen on Mitchell (UTA) and does not deliver contact.
Towns (MIN) grabs and holds Ingles's (UTA) body during the rebound and affects his ability to get to the loose ball.
Deng (MIN) commits a take foul on Ingles (UTA).
Towns (MIN) is established in a screening position in Mitchell's (UTA) path and he does not deliver contact.
Bayless (MIN) commits a take foul on Mitchell (UTA).
